title: Trace Frames Through a Robot Perception Graph
summary: Resolve a rigid transform between two frames in a validated acyclic frame forest.

frames: named right-handed frames in supplied forest
physical_contract.axes: An edge (parent,child,T) stores T_parent_child mapping child coordinates into parent.
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Every edge belongs to the same synchronized calibration snapshot; no time interpolation.
physical_contract.batching: list of up to128 (parent:str,child:str,T(4,4)) tuples, source/target str -> fresh float64(4,4).

provenance.authoring_notes: Original robotics-foundation exercise; no paper headline result or external dataset.
